subject.title: [Feature]: Start screen "Recent chats" is visual noise — make collapsible, dismissible, or replaceable by suggestions

question: Should the unified Control UI start screen always show suggestions before recent chats, or should it instead preserve recents as the primary element with a new collapse or preference control?
rationale: Both choices are viable UX policies, but they differ in navigation priority, discoverability, and whether OpenClaw gains a persisted preference surface; source evidence does not establish an existing approved hierarchy.

options.title: Show suggestions first
options.body: Always render the existing suggestions above recents and retain recents as a secondary quick-resume affordance without new settings.

options.title: Add per-user collapse
options.body: Keep recents prominent by default but add a persisted collapse control for users who prefer a cleaner start screen.

options.title: Remove start-screen recents
options.body: Use the sidebar as the sole session-navigation surface and keep the start screen focused on starting a new prompt.

recommendation.title: Show suggestions first
recommendation.body: Always render the existing suggestions above recents and retain recents as a secondary quick-resume affordance without new settings.

likelyOwner.reason: The related completed start-screen direction was authored by steipete, making this a direct follow-up product hierarchy decision.
